Fake KovaaK's install used by the KovaaK's import tests (see STATE/HANDOFF_KOVAAKS.md).

Layout mirrors <Steam library>/steamapps/common/FPSAimTrainer/:
  FPSAimTrainer/sounds/*.ogg|*.wav           custom sounds (name = file stem)
  FPSAimTrainer/crosshairs/*.png             crosshair images
  FPSAimTrainer/Saved/SaveGames/Themes/*.json
  FPSAimTrainer/Saved/SaveGames/PrimaryUserSettings.json
  FPSAimTrainer/Saved/SaveGames/weaponsettings.ini   (UTF-8 BOM + CRLF, like the real file)

Everything here is original and CC0: the sounds are sine tones generated with ffmpeg
(lavfi "sine" source), the PNG is generated by a script, and every JSON/INI value is
invented. Only the file/key layout matches KovaaK's. Do not add files copied from a
real KovaaK's install or from community themes.

Edge cases on purpose: broken.json (truncated JSON), broken.ogg (not Vorbis),
lgduel_adpcm.wav (IMA ADPCM, unsupported -> clear error), lgduel_88k.ogg (88.2 kHz
stereo -> resampling), "!lgduel minimal.json" (optional keys missing, '!' in the name).
